transcript.text: Hi everyone, thanks for being here. I've got one open booking slot on Sunday, October 6, at the Riverside Hall for a wedding reception, and Quinn has floated the idea of a photography-for-espresso-cart swap. Before I make any final decision on whether to accept and on what terms, I want to go around the table once. Each of you, please state any deal term, practical constraint, or relevant comparison you think I should hear. Let's start with you, Quinn.

transcript.text: My exact barter proposal is this: Maya serves espresso and other drinks for 3 hours, serves exactly 60 drinks, and receives 40 edited digital photographs in a private gallery, with no cash changing hands.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Maya, I want to put a concrete alternative on the table for your consideration: I can offer you a confirmed cash booking for exactly $700 for a 4-hour event on that same Sunday afternoon, October 6.
